text: maṃ bhante bhagavā anusāsatu maṃ bhante bhagavā yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti . evametaṃ gahapati evametaṃ gahapati āturo hāyaṃ 2 gahapati kāyo aṇḍabhūto pariyonaddho #1 po. ma. susumāragire . 2 yu. te . yo hi gahapati imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttaṃpi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya kimaññatra bālyā tasmā tiha te gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatīti evaṃ
